summary: iter95ax smart auto-detect (Wyceny SubRow) — 5/6 tests PASS. TEST A (empty unit auto-fill m³), TEST B (mismatch warning + fix button), TEST C (fix-unit click), TEST D (✓ match badge), TEST F (plain number PATCH with quantity_formula:null) all pass. TEST E (invalid formula =abc + 5) FAILS: evalFormula in _shared.js silently strips unknown identifiers via regex group m[4] without adding to cleanExpr, so '=abc + 5' is accepted as '+5' = 5 with empty unit instead of raising 'Niepoprawna formuła'. No toast.error fires, badge logic just silently does nothing.

integration_issues.issue: Expected toast.error('Formuła: ...') but none fires. evalFormula() in /app/frontend/src/components/wyceny/_shared.js (line 47-67) regex captures the unknown identifier 'abc' in capture group m[4], but the if/else if chain only handles m[1] (number) / m[3] (operator) — m[4] is silently consumed and dropped. Resulting cleanExpr becomes '+5' → evaluates to 5 with empty unit. No error returned, so saveQty stores quantity=5 + unit unchanged and no warning is shown to user. Should add `else if (m[4]) return { error: 'Niepoprawna formuła: nieznany identyfikator ' + m[4] }` (or push token causing cleanExpr validation to fail).

action_items: Fix evalFormula in /app/frontend/src/components/wyceny/_shared.js so unknown identifiers (m[4]) produce an error result instead of being silently dropped. Easiest patch: after the while-loop, also reject if the original 's' contains residual letters not consumed as units, e.g. `if (/[a-zA-ZąęóśłżźćńĄĘÓŚŁŻŹĆŃ]/.test(s.replace(/m²|m³|cm|mm|mb|kg|l|szt|kpl|godz|h|m|t/g,'').replace(/[a-zA-Z]/g,''))) return { error: 'Niepoprawna formuła' }`. Or simply add `else if (m[4]) return { error: 'Niepoprawna formuła: ' + m[4] }` inside the while loop.
critical_code_review_comments: evalFormula silently accepts garbage tokens (variables / function names) by dropping the m[4] capture group → user can type formulas that look invalid but quietly evaluate to a partial sum. Recommend explicit reject.
saveQty correctly differentiates empty/mismatch/match for unit auto-detect, but relies entirely on evalFormula's error reporting for invalid input. The bug above hides errors from the user.

rca_of_the_issue: TEST E root cause: evalFormula regex in /app/frontend/src/components/wyceny/_shared.js line 47 has 4 capture groups (number+unit / number / operator / identifier). The while loop body only handles m[1] and m[3], so m[4] (free identifier like 'abc') is silently consumed and lost. cleanExpr for '=abc + 5' becomes '+5' (valid JS, evals to 5). evalFormula returns {value:5, unit:'', error:null}. saveQty therefore treats it as a valid formula and PATCHes quantity=5; no toast.error is emitted; no warning visible to the user. Fix: either return {error:'Niepoprawna formuła'} when m[4] matches, or post-validate that s has no leftover letters.
